definitions.explanation: The act of cutting something into small or thin pieces. Most commonly refers to shredding documents for security purposes.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}を{細断|さいだん}する。
{個人情報|こじんじょうほう}が{書|か}かれた{紙|かみ}は{必|かなら}ず{細断|さいだん}してから{捨|す}ててください。
examples.english: Please always shred paper containing personal information before disposing of it.

examples.japanese: オフィスには{機密|きみつ}{文書|ぶんしょ}を{細断|さいだん}するためのシュレッダーが{設置|せっち}されている。
examples.english: A shredder for shredding confidential documents is installed in the office.

notes:
Composed of {細|さい} (fine, thin) + {断|だん} (to cut). While it can refer to any kind of fine cutting, in modern usage it is most strongly associated with shredding documents for information security.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細断|さいだん}する — to shred
- {細断|さいだん}{処理|しょり} — shredding (as a process)
- {細断|さいだん}{機|き} — shredder (alternative to シュレッダー)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裁断|さいだん} — cutting (fabric, paper); same reading but different kanji, refers to cutting material to a pattern
- {粉砕|ふんさい} — pulverizing, crushing; more thorough destruction into powder or fragments
- シュレッダーにかける — to put through a shredder; everyday expression for the same action
